content: Recent studies have demonstrated that the systems trained on the human-written texts learn human-like biases BIBREF1 , BIBREF6 . In general, any predictive model built on historical data may inadvertently inherit human biases based on gender, ethnicity, race, or religion BIBREF7 , BIBREF8 . Discrimination-aware data mining focuses on measuring discrimination in data as well as on evaluating performance of discrimination-aware predictive models BIBREF9 , BIBREF10 , BIBREF11 , BIBREF12 .
